sentry: Stand here, they said. Watch the radio, they said.
This radio has more friends than me.
I've counted every leaf on that tree. Twice.
Nobody ever attacks on MY shift. Nobody ever visits either.
mutter: Twelve hours. In the rain. Again.
Who even needs a radio tower out here?
My boots are full of jungle.
Guard the trees, they said. Great career move.
If one more mosquito bites me...
I had a nice desk job once.
investigate: If this is the monkey again...
gunfire: Gunfire?! Of course. Of course there's gunfire.
lost: Come out, I just want to shoot you a little.
giveup: Nobody here. Back to being miserable.
won: That's what you get. Ugh, more paperwork.
flank: I'll go round! Keep him busy!
Going left! Or right! One of those!
alarm: We've got company! The rude kind!
alarmheard: Hold on, I'm coming! Don't win without me!
body: Oh no. Oh, that's going to be paperwork.
Man down! Who's going to watch the radio now?!
cover: Behind the tree! The tree is my friend!
You can't hit me, I'm a tree now!
tree: Did a tree just... fall over? By itself?
The jungle is falling apart. Like my career.

guard_chats: Is it my shift or yours?
The radio is the only one here with any sense.

hostile: You again. The rice remembers what you did.
My grandmother has a stick. She knows about you.
wary: Mm. Boots off the paddy, please.
Another man with a gun. Lovely.
friendly: Ah! Our friend with the loud stick!
Hello! You look hungry. You always look hungry.
Good day! Mind the buffalo. Metaphorically.
Back again? Bring rain, not trouble.
loyal: Our hero! Sit, sit, eat something!
The children made a song about you. It's mostly about your boots.
Whatever you need. Within reason. And rice.
chat: The rain is late. Or early. The rain does what it wants.
My cousin says the soldiers are scared of frogs.
Fifty years I plant rice. Rice still doesn't say thank you.
If it rains again I'm building a boat.
The headman says patience. The headman has a bad back.
Who keeps leaving half a tree on the path?
Did you sell the duck? ...You ATE the duck?!
The checkpoint boys took a whole sack again.
My knees can tell you the weather. They say: no.
panic: Why is it always during lunch?!
work: One plant, two plant... ow, my back.
rain: Here it comes. Everybody under a roof!
morning: Morning. Tea. Then rice. Then more rice.
Who let the rooster near my window again?
night: Goodnight, everyone! Lock up the chickens.
Bed. Finally. My back is filing a complaint.
sell: Best prices in the jungle! Only prices in the jungle!

radio_banter.text: Whoever took the last tin of peaches: we know. We are watching. We are hungry.
Reminder: the jungle is not a toilet. Well. It is. But be discreet.
Echo Two to anyone. Has anyone seen my left boot? ...Echo Two out.
Weather office says rain. Weather office always says rain. Weather office is usually right.
Supply run delayed. The mule has opinions.
Morale officer reports morale is fine. Morale officer has been asked to stop writing reports in crayon.
Bravo Six here. We found a frog the size of a dog. It's ours now. His name is Kevin.
Radio discipline, people. That means less singing.
Found the boot. There was a frog in it. Not Kevin. Different frog.
To whoever keeps knocking trees over: forestry has filed a complaint. We have filed it under 'jungle'.
If you find building supplies at their camps, keep them. They owe us for the peaches.
Night patrols: check your torch. Then switch it off. Then never switch it on near the enemy.
